MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
26000198
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F00454725
CITIGROUP MORTGAGE LOAN
TRUST 2021-RP4, is the Plaintiff,
and FAIRY AGHA, ET ALS., are
Defendants, writ of execution for
the sale of mortgaged premises
dated 12/17/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 8TH DAY of APRIL,
A.D. 2026, at the hour of one thirty
o'clock by the then prevailing (Standard or Daylight Saving) time, in the
afternoon of the said day, at the
Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Ave,
New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the TOWNSHIP OF WOODBRIDGE,
in the County of Middlesex, and
State of New Jersey.
Premises commonly known as: 257
COLUMBUS AVENUE, WOODBRIDGE,
NJ 07095.
Tax Lot: 14.02 f/k/a 14.B; Block:
263.02 f/k/a 263.B; Dimensions of Lot: 50 X 80.
Nearest Cross Street: BUNNS LANE.
Upset price: $277,000.00 *Note,
this upset price is subject to
increase as of the date of the sale
and you will need to contact the
sheriff of plaintiff's counsel for the
upset as it exists on the date of sale.
Occupancy: Said property is occupied.
*Taxes - at time of inquiry - taxes
paid through 4th quarter 2025;
*Water - Private account, verification of same prohibited without
authorization of record property owner
*Sewer - at the time of inquiry -
delinquent in the amount of
$789.57 + interest and any additional charges that may become due through payoff;
(XX) Subject to: if property is
located in a Homeowner's Association, then it is sold subject to any assessments and other fees which
may be responsibility of new owner
under NJ Supreme Court case of
Highland Lakes Country Club &
Community Association v. Franzino,
186 N.J. 99 (2006);
(XX) Subject to: if properly is
located in a Condominium or Homeowners' Association, then it may be
sold subject to a 6-month limited
priority lien of the association;
(XX) Subject to: *If the subject
property is part of an age restricted
community, you must be 55 and
older and intent to reside in the
property or you may be precluded
membership in the Community.
*Also subject to subsequent taxes,
water and sewer plus interest
through date of payoff.
A FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION OF THE
PREMISES CAN BE FOUND IN THE
OFFICE OF THE SHERIFF OF MIDDLESEX COUNTY
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES
THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE
WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE
THROUGH PUBLICATION.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of TWO HUNDRED FIFTY
THREE THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED
FIFTY FIVE DOLLARS AND FIFTY
TWO CENTS ($253 ,655.52)
DOLLARS more or less, plus interest
together with the costs of this
sale. THE UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE
SUBJECT TO FURTHER ORDERS OF
ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of
sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
ROMANO, GARUBO & ARGENTIERI
52 NEWTON AVENUE
WOODBURY, NJ 08096
Attorneys
